question.en: Discuss the significance of Basel III norms in strengthening the resilience of the Indian banking sector.
question.hi: Discuss the significance of Basel III norms in strengthening the resilience of the Indian banking sector.

modelAnswer.en: Basel III norms enhance capital quality, introduce liquidity buffers (LCR and NSFR), and mitigate leverage. For India, this helps in managing NPAs, improving risk management, and aligning with global standards, thereby ensuring financial stability.
